purpose: Exercise existing LP native consumer on an authentic retained producer panel; descriptive research only. No hypothesis of profitable prediction or causal identification.
question: What is the descriptive monthly payroll-log-level response associated with one percentage point of CPI month-on-month change, using vintage values known by each selected CPI vintage anchor?

periods.cadence: exactly one observation per calendar month; require full contiguous range, never condition selection on numeric outcomes

selection: For each month choose earliest retained CPI vintage strictly after month-end and at most45 calendar days later; choose prior-month CPI and current-month PAYEMS latest vintages no later than this anchor. Reject missing/late/duplicate/invalid data rather than revise range or impute. Earliest retained vintage is not asserted to be the true first publication.

transform.y: natural log of selected payroll level
transform.shock: 100*(log(selected CPI current period)-log(selected CPI prior period at same anchor))
transform.known_at: CPI anchor calendar date plus2days at00:00UTC; conservative bound on declared date-only availability, not invented exact intraday publication time

historical_clock_checks: All selected component vintage dates <=anchor; anchor dates strictly increasing; preceding control-row availability bounds <=current bound; all bounds<=cutoff. No future/current-revised substitution. Source-supplied vintage clocks are not independent rights/availability certification.
estimator: engine.local_projections.impulse_response unchanged; scripts/run_local_projections.py native CSV consumer
multiplicity: One honest family for all3 configurations; existing TrialLedger BEFORE each estimation; report total3 after all attempted. Existing BY adjustment covers4 dependent horizons within each run; search-count disclosure is not additional specification-search p-value correction. No selection of a best specification.
diagnostics: Retain all raw envelopes including nulls and typed abstentions, effective N, HAC request/actual, BY panel q, threats and bias direction. No causal/forecast/model-utility acceptance from significance.
success_criterion: Engineering: exact authentic input bytes consumed and registration retained before estimator, complete native run/readback under released source. Scientific: no promotion gate; report all outcomes without threshold-based winner selection.
threats: Endogenous CPI/payroll common causes; association does not identify causal response
Monthly release-date approximation and conservative2day delay; no intraday forecast claim
Earliest retained-vintage availability can differ from original initial release; strict45day bound excludes archive-floor pseudo-first rows
